memo_sentence: Dental supplies and lab fees rose $52,700, or 38.1 percent, on the implant cases the new surgical suite took on in June.
Hygienist wages rose $54,900, or 25.7 percent, on the second hygiene chair that opened at the Ashburn office on 1 June.
Orthodontic plan revenue rose $42,400, or 44.2 percent, as the thirty-one new orthodontic plans that started in June began billing.
Patient service revenue rose $61,500, or 8.3 percent, as the two associate dentists who started in May reached a full patient schedule in June. The movement fails the percentage leg of the threshold.
Marketing and patient outreach rose $5,700, or 31.0 percent, on the new patient mailer delivered in the first week of June. The movement fails the dollar leg of the threshold.
